summary: Leecher's tree-top crow's nest, dated 1918 or 1920, stands about 1,000 ft south of the summit tower and survived the 2014 Carlton Complex fire.

facts.design: Tree-top crow's nest, a platform in a tree, about 1,000 ft south of the summit tower

access.note: Summit road gated; TrailChick reports the gate kept closed as of 2019. Tree is a few hundred feet off the roadway per WillhiteWeb.

visit.trail_note: Park at the gate if it is closed. If the road is gated, the walk to the main lookout is a little over a mile (TrailChick).

events.note: Tree-top crow's nest about 1,000 ft south of the summit; firelookout.com, TrailChick and WillhiteWeb say 1918, NHLR says 1920
Carlton Complex fire burned neighboring trees; the crow's nest survived

corrections.proposed: Tree-top crow's nest about 1,000 ft south of the summit; not the current summit structure
corrections.why: The summit's current structure is the 1954 tower (MVFFLA). The 1918 crow's nest is a separate, older structure about 1,000 ft south. The TrailChick header that reads 'Current Structure Built: 1918' conflicts with the same page's history, which names the 1954 tower as the current structure.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: 1918 per TrailChick, WillhiteWeb and firelookout.com; 1920 per NHLR. The record uses 1918 and the story gives both.
TrailChick names Okanogan-Wenatchee National Forest; firelookout.com names Okanogan National Forest for the same site. Record keeps the TrailChick name.

notes_for_editor: This is the crow's nest, a separate structure about 1,000 ft south of the summit tower. The summit tower is covered by us-wa-leecher-mountain (existing story and research on the same mountain); the two records should be linked. Dates: 1918 (TrailChick, WillhiteWeb, firelookout.com, MVFFLA 'around 1918') versus 1920 (NHLR). No staffing data for the crow's nest itself. firelookout.com lists named personnel from 1920 on but does not say which structure they staffed, so none is used. WillhiteWeb says 'likely built as a patrol point' (author's inference, kept as 'likely'). Access is from TrailChick (gate closed as of 2019) and may be stale; WillhiteWeb's route is via French Creek Road, and its access note reads 'Good Gravel'. The record's 'Current structure' note is the main error and is in corrections. Photos on the record are TrailChick's and are not re-added.
